featured_reviews.name: Lizzie Chapman
featured_reviews.review_text:
Hands down the best co working space in Mumbai (maybe the world??). It's truly a joy to work here and I feel so much more creative and productive after a day in Ministry (what are these magic vibes!). The space is absolutely stunning, but it's also really clean, comfortable and we'll maintained. Bathrooms are clean and plentiful, WiFi works like a dream, noise levels are low and Aircon is just right. so all the basics are taken care of allowing you to focus on your work. The cafe is also brilliant, so you never need to leave. Literally. Do try the chicken ramen and the home made ice tea. 😋

It's all the small touches that make this place so magical. The complimentary water with mint added, the endless tea and coffee, the brilliant community events, the daily birthday celebrations for members. And most of all the COMMUNITY and how people come together to help and support each other with their work. It's truly like a utopian future of work!!

Become a MON member, it will change your life. 💕

featured_reviews.name: Aliabbas Delhiwala
featured_reviews.review_text:
5 Stars - Exceptional Co-Working Experience

I've been working at Ministry of New for several months now as a lawyer, and I couldn't be happier with this space. The entire facility is impeccably maintained - everything from the main work areas to the washrooms is spotlessly clean and well-lit with fantastic natural lighting throughout.
What really sets this place apart are the thoughtful amenities. The zoom pod is perfect for my client calls and video conferences, and there's no additional charge for using it. They also have a spacious common area that's ideal for meetings and calls, again at no extra cost. When I need a more formal setting, their conference room easily accommodates 10-12 people, and they generously include 5 hours of usage monthly plus complimentary tea and coffee.
Marlies, who owns and manages the space, is absolutely wonderful. Her attention to detail and genuine care for the space and its members really shows. The entire staff is incredibly friendly and professional.
This is exactly what a co-working space should be - professional, well-maintained, and thoughtfully designed. Highly recommended!
